name: Device Headers
description: Generate client request headers for a platform, or parse a User-Agent string.

examples.label: Parse a User-Agent
examples.value: {"mode":"parseUa","userAgent":"Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"}

hints.platform: The first version supports built-in platforms and custom input only; no online UA lookup is used.
hints.output: The parse result distinguishes desktop, mobile, tablet and bot, and reports the rendering engine.

faq.q: Can these headers bypass risk controls?
faq.a: No. It is only a template of common headers for debugging and compatibility testing.

faq.q: Is the UA data kept up to date?
faq.a: Not automatically. The data is a built-in snapshot updated with tool releases.
